_meta.description: MassHealth policy pack rulebook. Every rule carries the source URL and the verbatim quote it was encoded from. source_status: 'fetched_verbatim' = quote copied from a source we downloaded on 2026-10-24; 'not_fetched' = the source blocked automated access (mass.gov returned HTTP 403), so the text comes from the team brief and the rule is marked needs_confirmation.

MH_WORK.title: MassHealth: New work and education requirements for MassHealth members

MH_HCFA.title: MassHealth Federal Changes to Eligibility & Enrollment (Sept 2026 stakeholder presentation)

rules.name: Under 19 or 65 and older: not subject to the requirement
rules.logic: age < 19 or age >= 65 at any part of the month
rules.quote: (1) At least 19 and under 65 years of age;

rules.name: Enrolled in Medicare Part A or B: not subject to the requirement
rules.logic: medicare_part_a or medicare_part_b enrollment documented
rules.quote: Entitled to or enrolled for Medicare benefits under part A or enrolled for benefits under part B of title XVIII of the Act;

rules.name: Work, community service or work program: 80+ hours in a month
rules.logic: sum(work, community service, work program hours) in one month >= 80
rules.quote: (1) The individual works not less than 80 hours.

rules.name: Monthly income of at least $580 (federal minimum wage x 80)
rules.logic: monthly earnings in one month >= 580.00
rules.quote: In 2026, the Federal minimum wage is $7.25 per hour,\41\ which multiplied by 80 equals $580.
rules.note: Federal rule says the agency uses MAGI-based household income; we only check the earnings documents provided.

rules.name: Enrolled in an educational program at least half-time
rules.logic: school-determined enrollment status is half-time or full-time
rules.quote: (4) The individual is enrolled in an educational program at least half-time.
rules.confirmation_note: The team brief summarises MassHealth's wording as 'at least part-time'; the federal rule says 'at least half-time' and that status 'is determined by the school or institution.' We apply half-time and flag letters that only say 'part-time'.

rules.name: Combination of work/service/work program + less-than-half-time education totalling 80 hours
rules.logic: work hours + (credits x 3 x 4.33) >= 80, for less-than-half-time enrollment
rules.quote: (i) Multiply the number of each one credit hour of instruction by 3 to get the total of education hours in a week.
rules.quote_2: (ii) Multiply the weekly total as determined under paragraph (d)(1)(i) of this section by 4.33 weeks to get total hours in a 1-month period.

rules.name: Parent/caretaker of a dependent child 13 or under
rules.logic: member is parent/guardian/caretaker relative of a child whose age is <= 13
rules.quote: Dependent child means a child 13 years of age or under who relies on another individual for care.

rules.name: Caregiver of a person with a disability
rules.logic: member lives with and regularly cares for a disabled individual, or is a relative giving regular care, or is a non-relative giving 80+ hours/month
rules.quote: (A) The individual primarily resides with a dependent child or disabled individual, as these terms are defined in this section, for whom he or she provides assistance that occurs on a regular basis and is not solely incidental in nature.
rules.confirmation_note: Which caregiving documentation MassHealth accepts (attestation vs. clinician letter) was not available from fetched sources.
rules.quote_2: Disabled individual means an individual who meets the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of disability at 28 CFR 35.108.

rules.name: Medically frail / special medical needs
rules.logic: qualifying condition (disability, SUD not in 5+yr stable recovery, disabling mental disorder, ADL-impairing disability, or serious/complex condition) AND documentation that it significantly impairs ability to comply (work)
rules.quote: An individual who is medically frail or otherwise has special medical needs is defined as an individual whose physical, mental, or other behavioral health condition significantly impairs the individual's ability to comply with the community engagement requirement
rules.confirmation_note: The state must publish its own list of qualifying conditions (435.554(c)(5)(ii)); MassHealth's list and exact letter requirements were not available. The tool requires the letter to state the functional impact on ability to work.

rules.name: Participating in drug or alcohol treatment and rehabilitation program
rules.logic: current enrollment in a SUD treatment program documented
rules.quote: (8) The individual is participating in a drug addiction or alcoholic treatment and rehabilitation program, as defined in section 3(h) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2012(h)).
rules.confirmation_note: States may set a minimum time commitment; MassHealth's threshold was not available.

rules.name: Pregnant or postpartum
rules.logic: currently pregnant, or delivery date within the postpartum window (placeholder 12 months)
rules.quote: (10) The individual is pregnant or entitled to postpartum medical assistance under section 1902(e)(5) or (16) of the Act.
rules.confirmation_note: The federal rule ties postpartum status to postpartum coverage; the length of MassHealth's postpartum period was not verified from fetched sources. The tool uses a configurable 12-month placeholder window and flags dates within 30 days of the boundary.

rules.name: In a SNAP household subject to (not exempt from) SNAP work requirements, or meeting TAFDC work requirements
rules.logic: SNAP notice states member is subject to work requirements, or TAFDC compliance documented
rules.quote: (7) The individual is a member of a household that receives Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits under 7 U.S.C. 2015 and is not exempt from a work requirement under such Act.

rules.name: Former foster youth (under 26)
rules.logic: documented foster care at age 18 and age < 26
rules.quote: (1) The individual meets the definition of the eligibility group serving former foster care children, described at section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i)(IX) of the Act

rules.name: Veteran with a total (100%) VA disability rating
rules.logic: VA rating letter shows 100% (total) rating
rules.quote: (4) The individual is a veteran with a temporary or permanent disability from the Department of Veterans Affairs, rated as 100 percent (total) under 38 U.S.C. 1155.

rules.name: Incarcerated or released within the past 3 months
rules.logic: release date within 3 months before the first day of the month
rules.quote: (b) At any point during the 3-month period ending on the first day of that month, the individual was an inmate of a public institution.

rules.name: American Indian / Alaska Native / Urban Indian
rules.logic: tribal enrollment or Indian status documentation
rules.quote: (2) The individual meets the definition of Indian at Sec.  447.51 of this subchapter.

rules.name: Person with a disability (e.g., SSI/SSDI award, blind or disabled under SSA 1614)
rules.logic: SSA disability award letter or equivalent
rules.quote: (A) Who is blind or disabled (as defined in section 1614 of the Social Security Act);
rules.confirmation_note: MassHealth lists 'people with disabilities' as its own exemption (team brief); in the federal rule this falls under medically frail. Accepted documentation not verified.

rules.name: 30 calendar days to respond after a notice of noncompliance
rules.logic: deadline = notice received date + 30 calendar days
rules.quote: Provide such individual with a period of 30 calendar days beginning on the date on which such notice of noncompliance is received by the individual
rules.confirmation_note: Day counting (whether day 1 is the received date) and MassHealth's mailing-date assumption should be confirmed; the tool counts received date + 30 days.

rules.name: State must check data it already has before asking the member
rules.logic: informational
rules.quote: The agency must establish processes to use reliable information available to the State to verify that an applicable individual has demonstrated community engagement

rules.name: No denial solely because documentation doesn't exist
rules.logic: informational: if no document exists, other information must be accepted
rules.quote: May not deny or terminate eligibility solely because the individual is unable to produce documentation where none exists or is reasonably available

rules.name: Before 2028, a statement under penalty of perjury may verify medical frailty
rules.logic: informational: suggest self-attestation as an interim option for frailty
rules.quote: Before January 1, 2028, when there is no reliable information available to the State or the reliable information is not reasonably compatible with the information provided by or on behalf of the individual, the agency may require documentation or accept a statement or other information under penalty of perjury
rules.confirmation_note: This is a state option ('may'); whether MassHealth accepts attestations was not verified.

rules.name: Renewal form: 45 days to complete (MassHealth)
rules.logic: informational
rules.quote: If it can't, it mails a renewal form (45 days to complete).
rules.confirmation_note: Taken from the team brief; mass.gov blocked automated retrieval.

rules.name: Only one qualifying month between renewals is needed
rules.logic: any single month in the lookback period suffices
rules.quote: demonstration of community engagement for 1 or more months, as specified in the State plan
rules.confirmation_note: The brief says MassHealth requires one month; the federal rule lets the state plan specify '1 or more'.
